en: (Haruka wants to score <Color:8>at least 900 points on "Because I Have You."<Color:Default>)
Okay. Maybe next time then...
(I don't have enough money...)
(I should give Haruka-chan a call.)
Ya called me up from Kamurocho, knowin' I'm a busy student lookin' for a job, just to sing karaoke? Is this some kinda joke?
My deepest apologies.
(I should call Akiyama-san.)
Sorry for the delay, Haruka-chan!
Kiryu-san! I'm begging you! Could you please be my stand-in?
Whoa, I don't believe it! Is that you, Kiryu-san!?
You know me?
Of course I do! It's me, Noboru Kudarizaka! You remember, right? I asked you to stand in for me when I was shooting that period piece. Long time no see!
That does sound somewhat familiar...
But man, I didn't expect to run into you here! I guess the stars aligned for me! There must be a god after all!
Why do you say that?
I'm working on a new project, but I hurt myself just as shooting was about to start. Again.
The thought of bringing this up to the director has had me biting my nails this entire time! I'll have to get another two-hour manicure...
Anyway. You've already done this before, so I really need your help! Can you stand in for me again?
So I'm gonna be in yet another movie, huh...
Sorry. You'll have to find someone else.
What!? But you're my only hope! Please, at least give it some thought!
Okay, I'll do it.
Great! Thanks a bunch!
So what's the role this time?
Oh, it's the perfect role for you, Kiryu-san! It's a yakuza action movie! All you have to do is rough some people up! And I use the term "people" loosely.
Well, I guess I could pull off an action role.
Awesome! Then I'll take you to the set right away!
Oh, that sale puts you over the million yen mark!
I sold ya that much already?
You've been an incredible help. I'll be able to meet this year's quota now! Here, take a little something for yourself.
You got <Color:8>Staminan Royale<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Bloody Binding<Color:Default>.
Ya sure? Thanks.
There's no such thing as too much inventory. As long as you keep bringing me wild game, I'm a happy man.
I hope we'll continue to do business together!
Saejima-san, are those...?
Yup, took down a bear this time. Have at 'em.
You handed over <Color:8>Bear Bile<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>102,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You just might be the greatest business partner in history! I think I'm all set now.
Sure hope so.
Why does that yakuza even want this stuff? Is he just makin' oddball demands to punish ya or somethin'?
No, it's not like that. He's... uh... Well, you can keep a secret, right?
These dumb requests came from a family boss⑬a guy whose ego is somehow twice the size of his fat ass.
Yeah. This fool apparently told another yakuza that he was some big-shot hunter.
And of course, he'd never even hunted before. So this was his solution when the other guy asked to see his trophies.
Ya tellin' me I did all this huntin' just to cover for his pride?
Yeah, but hey, there's still some good news⑬he knows he can't keep this up, so he already told everyone that this is his last hunt, because he finally bagged a bear.
But hey, I'm sorry for dragging you into this mess. At least I'll be free of the bastards now! Thank you for that.
Here's something for all your trouble.
You got <Color:8>Fearless Binding<Color:Default>.
Thanks. I'm thinkin' we should just try to stay outta stuff like this from now on, both 'a us.
I couldn't agree more.
Hey Saejima! You know I'm counting on you to deliver that bear for me!
So, anything I can help you with right now?
Can I help you with anything else?
Thank you. Your business is always appreciated.
Hi, Saejima-san. Thank you for bringing me that entire deer! That was a huge help.
Not to worry⑬we're tradin' favors with each other, after all.
I've got great news. I think if I finish this one last job, I'll be free of the yakuza for good.
Ya sure 'bout that? Just one more job?
It should be. I mean, we signed an official contract and everything... stating this last transaction would settle all debts.
Alright, what's their last order, then?
Nothin' much shocks me anymore. Say it.
Argh... I hate to ask for this, but I need... an entire bear.
The whole thing? Ya mean the meat, fur, fat, and bile?
All of it. But then we'll be done, I promise! Please help me out one last time.
"Sell a Whole Bear" was added to the list of missions.
All 'a this oughta do it!
Sure hope so, after all this effort.
It took a while, but here ya go.
You handed over <Color:8>Deer Meat<Color:Default>.
You handed over <Color:8>Deer Hide<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>26,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Fantastic! If this doesn't get them off my back, I don't know what will!
Hope ya know what yer talkin' about.
Hey Saejima-san, I've got an order here for one whole deer. That should make for a handsome reward if you bring one to me.
Saejima-san! Hey listen, you think you can help me out again?
In what way?
It's that customer from Tokyo, again⑬the one that kept placing all those ridiculous orders you already helped me with.
It turns out... he's a yakuza! Can you believe that!?
...It happens.
And this time, the request was so outrageous, I just rejected it outright! But then they <Italic>threatened</Italic> me.
What's the request?
One whole deer. The meat, the hide, at least one antler.
Fine, I'll take care of it. But tell 'em this is the last time, alright?
Yes, of course. I'm so sorry for imposing on you again.
"Sell a Whole Deer" was added to the list of missions.
Here ya go.
Hello, Saejima. Ooh, what've you got there?
Yup, fresh deer. Take it.
Excellent! This is a big help!
You got <Color:8>6,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Thank you so much. Surely once I give him this, I won't be hearing from him ever again!
Hey Saejima, I'm still waiting on that deer meat, you know!
Um... um, hey, Saejima-san...?
Lemme guess⑬is it that troublesome customer of yours again?
I'm so sorry for imposing again! It's just... well, they're asking for deer meat now. Just one slab, though.
I'll pay you a premium for it! The customer has promised me that this is his last request.
I definitely ain't cut out for yer job⑬I'd be screamin' at this guy till his ears bled. But I'll get ya that deer meat.
Thank you. I really do appreciate it, so much.
"Sell Deer Meat" was added to the list of missions.
I got some deer meat on me. Here, give this to yer customer.
Oh, great! You're a lifesaver.
Thank you so much. Honestly, I think this will be it from that customer.
It prob'ly ain't.
Fox skin. Go 'head, take it.
Thank you! This is a huge boon for my business!
You handed over <Color:8>Fox Skin<Color:Default>.
I really appreciate you helping me out. The customer is sure to be happy, now!
Gotta keep yer customers happy.
Hi, Saejima-san. Thank you for handling that one fox skin order.
Oh, Saejima-san! Hello! ...Um, hey, I was wondering if I could ask for another favor.
What is it? That Tokyo customer again?
Yes. He was hoping to buy a fox skin. Do you think that would be possible?
Of course, I can offer you higher pay for such a thing.
Yeah, I'll give it a go. That customer of yours sure ain't easy to please.
I'm so sorry to ask you for this, but it would really help.
"Sell a Fox Skin" was added to the list of missions.
Got a nice fox skin here. Go ahead and give it to yer customer.
Wow... it's beautiful! Thank you, Saejima-san!
If he ain't, there's no helpin' him.
Hello, Saejima. Ooh, is that luxurious-looking item what I think it is?
Yup, it's yer marten pelt.
You got <Color:8>12,000 yen<Color:Default>.
You saved me from losing a customer. Thank you.
Hi there, Saejima-san. I'm still holding out hope you'll get that marten pelt for me.
Oh, Saejima-san. I was wondering if you could help me.
Whaddya need?
Uh, could I possibly buy a marten pelt off you? I'll offer double what I usually pay.
In a bind?
Kind of. One of my regular customers in Tokyo just sent me an urgent order for a marten pelt.
If I can't fill it quickly, they're going to stop doing business with me. It's totally unreasonable, but at the same time... It's one of my best customers, so I don't want to lose 'im.
Well, since I need yer business myself, I'll see what I can do.
Oh, that would be such a big help...
Naturally, since it's for such an important customer, I'll have to inspect it carefully before buying.
Not that I don't trust you! But just to be safe, please deliver it personally to me. Okay?
The trader will pay double his usual price for items special-ordered by the VIP customer. They must be handed over in person, so place them in your <Color:7>Inventory<Color:Default> first.
"Sell a Marten Pelt" was added to the list of missions.
I've got a marten pelt here. If this'll do, it's yours.
Oh, wow! You're the best, Saejima-san!
Oh, hi there. Say, have you heard the story about the Jizo statues?
What's this, now?
Well, there are these twelve Jizo statues on the mountain.
What is this, some kinda ghost story?
Oh no, no, not at all! In fact, I'm talking about <Italic>beneficial</Italic> spirits. You see, in the old days, hunters would pray to a Jizo statue if they happened to come across one.
It makes sense that the hunters were superstitious. I mean, the mountain is such a dangerous place...
But what if it worked? Some people have sworn that the Jizo statues kept them from getting lost in the wild.
It ain't hard to understand why folks turn to superstition.
Well, if you ask me, it can't hurt. If I came across a Jizo statue up there, I'd pray to it. Why not?
Uh-huh...
"Pray to Jizo Statues" was added to the list of missions.
So, would you like anything today?
Oh hello, Saejima. Can I help you with something?
Ah, just the man I wanted to see!
I heard about how you sent Yama-oroshi running.
Pretty impressive. With those kind of hunting skills, I was wondering if I could ask a favor of you.
Well, because of the Yama-oroshi trouble, all the hunters around here are reluctant to hunt on the mountain.
Can't blame 'em, with that beast roamin' around.
Of course, of course. I can certainly understand. But it's made it very difficult for me to source any merchandise.
But maybe you, if you go to the mountain, would be willing to sell me any game you bag?
It could be meat, hides, or even vegetation. What do you think?
Don't get yer hopes up. I don't plan on goin' on any huntin' sprees.
Oh, I understand. I wasn't asking for reckless slaughter or anything! I have to maintain a good relationship with this village too, you know.
Alright. I'll do what I can. How much game do ya need?
Not much... About a million yen worth.
A million yen! I can't imagine what it'd take to equal that!
Not as much as you'd think. Don't worry⑬you'll see what the prices are really like once you bring me a few things. I'm counting on you!
"Supply the Trader" was added to the list of missions.
So, can I help you with anything today?
Got a minute?
Yes, of course. How can I help you?
Ya do business here, dontcha? Thought I'd introduce myself, since I've just started huntin', which means I'll be needin' yer services soon 'nuff.
Oh, I see. Pleased to make your acquaintance⑬I was wondering who the muscly new guy was!
It's been quite a while since any newcomers were around.
Makes sense, in a place like this.
"In a place like this"? You know, this mountain is actually pretty famous, because of the outstanding quality of its animal meats and skins.
Oh, yes. The meat is prized at the most high-end restaurants in Tokyo, and the skins trade at high prices inside the most luxurious fur stores.
I mean, I assumed that's why you were hunting here in the first place.
Uh, ya might say that. I knew there was choice game, but I didn't know it was that good.
It's some of the best around! Heck, ten years ago, hunters would come up here all the way from Honshu.
It's not quite like that anymore, though.
(Ten years ago? That's when Okudera-han started livin' in the village, right after he was rescued.)
Still, the primo quality of wild game on this mountain remains unmatched. That's why I still come here to trade.
Well, lookin' forward to doin' business with ya.
You ready to go, Saejima?
Hi, Saejima. I'm happy to do business with you. Can I help you with anything today?
Urrggh... A bunch of guys showed up at the dojo... Master Sodachi's in trouble...
